## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `BenzingaFirmId` | String | The unique identifier assigned by Benzinga to the research firm or investment bank. | REST |
| `BenzingaId` | String | The identifier used by Benzinga for this record. | REST |
| `FirmName` | String | The name of the research firm or investment bank issuing the ratings. | REST |
| `FullName` | String | The full name of the analyst associated with the ratings. | REST |
| `LastUpdated` | Instant | The timestamp (formatted as an ISO 8601 timestamp) when the analyst record was last updated in the system. | REST |
| `OverallAvgReturn` | double | The average percent price difference per rating since the date of recommendation. | REST |
| `OverallAvgReturnPercentile` | double | The analyst's percentile rank based on average return, relative to other analysts. | REST |
| `OverallSuccessRate` | double | The percentage of gain/loss ratings that resulted in a gain overall. | REST |
| `SmartScore` | double | A weighted average of the total_ratings_percentile, overall_avg_return_percentile, and overall_success_rate. | REST |
| `TotalRatings` | double | The total number of ratings issued by the analyst included in the performance calculation. | REST |
| `TotalRatingsPercentile` | double | The analyst's percentile rank based on the total number of ratings issued, relative to other analysts. | REST |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST |
